Video editing was tougher than the code 😭

Built GeoTrade : live at www.web-code.tech

Instead of relying on tons of external open Ai  APIs, most of the intelligence runs through a local ML pipeline.

News from sources like Reuters and Bloomberg flows into an NLP stack that performs: 
• transformer-based event classification 
• sentiment analysis for geopolitical stress 
• clustering to detect emerging macro narratives 

These signals are aggregated into a Geopolitical Tension Index, which then feeds a LightGBM model predicting things like volatility spikes, bullish/bearish bias, and macro risk shifts.

The frontend visualizes everything on a live world map — click any continent to see the event and its possible market impact. Currently fixing a few too-many-requests issues because the demo got a bit more traffic than expected causing it to fall back to demo data.
